title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode19 The Flying Show?!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mikuuu!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Emuuu!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! It's been a while! How have your Wonder Stage performances been going?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They've been a smash hit, of course! With a star such as myself on the team, you hardly need to ask!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We came to say thank you to the two of you.
Thanks for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey! Stop stealing my lines!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You always needlessly drag things out. I was simply getting to the point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why, you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We really do owe you quite a lot.
Please accept my thanks as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm just happy we could be of assistance to you and your shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahem! That actually brings us to our reason for coming today. Would you let us watch your show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our show? Of course. But why the sudden request?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were discussing what to do for our next big performance, but everyone had such different opinions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We thought it'd be best to come and see what kinds of shows you perform and how you integrate everyone's ideas.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, so that's why you've come.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Trying to incorporate so many opinions is harder than I thought it would be. It's even worse when everyone always suggests utterly insane ideas in opposition to my own...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what happens when you have so many people working together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, that is also what leads to new ideas.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Accepting everyone's differing talents and opinions is a great way to come up with wonderful show ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. I suppose that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! I know!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa! You startled me! What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since everyone is here, let's use our new attraction☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: New attraction?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Over there! It's a flying train!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A flying train?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-W-Wow!!! It's really flying! Woohoo☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll just make sure Robo-Nene is strapped in tight. There.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So how exactly does this thing fly, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The power source must be in the engine room. Ah, I see. I'm going to have to come back and take a closer look at this later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What kind of show are you going to do up here?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ahem! Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Please join me today on a journey through the skies! Is everyone ready?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, a kind of participatory performance? This could be fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Please keep your hands and feet inside the train! The wind is quite strong and we wouldn't want anyone falling out!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu! Miku! Th-They both went out the window...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha?! Did they fall?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, good. They managed to grab onto the door handle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Eek! It's so high! Oh, look!
You can see the stage from up here♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! It looks so small☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-This is no time to be enjoying the scenery! Grab hold!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa, give me your hand! Rui, you too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure. Nene, there's a tow cable installed in Robo-Nene. Could you tie it around my waist and help pull us up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You even installed a cable?
Hey, aren't you a little calm considering the situation we're in?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I thought I was a goner...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was so much fun! Thanks for saving me, everyone! You were all superstars☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry you weren't able to see our show after all, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, well. I guess it wasn't a complete loss.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It wasn't?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu is always pulling one crazy stunt after another. But looking at it from another perspective, that just means she's able to come up with ideas I would never think of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui is always taking an interest in one thing or another and turning ideas into something tangible. And Nene's ability to keep calm is always helpful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This made me realize that together, we'll be able to come up with some fantastic shows for sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, that wouldn't be possible without the great, shining star that is me to bring it all together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ever since re-discovering his true feelings, Tsukasa has started acting more and more like a troupe leader.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad we could be of help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I hope you'll all come back again, Tsukasa.
We'll be sure to put on an even better show next time!
